# Knya Medical Apparel

> Knya is an online retailer specializing in premium medical scrubs, lab coats, and healthcare apparel for doctors, nurses, and medical professionals.

Knya offers a comprehensive range of medical uniforms featuring proprietary fabric technologies like Ecoflex™ with 4-way stretch, available in multiple styles (V-neck, mandarin collar, full-sleeve), colors, and fits. The site caters to healthcare professionals seeking comfortable, durable, and professionally-designed medical apparel.
